name: Dranaz Tunnel
facts: The Dranaz Tunnel, spanning 2,016 meters, was excavated from both ends, achieving breakthrough in July 2002 after 18 months of tunnelling.
Inside a single tube, the tunnel carries one lane of traffic in each direction, equipped with Siemens‑supplied power, lighting, ventilation, and fire‑fighting systems.
Prime Minister Recep Tayyip Erdoğan officially opened the Dranaz Tunnel to traffic on 14 February 2009, marking a milestone for the Sinop–Boyabat corridor.
